--- COMMAND: uci export 2>/dev/null ---
package system
config system
	option hostname 'rtr-openwrt-01'
config timeserver 'ntp'
	list server '0.openwrt.pool.ntp.org'
package network
config interface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '10.10.6.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'
	list dns '9.9.9.9'
